output.summary: formatPrice (TypeScript) gains a required currency parameter and tax (Python) gains an optional rate parameter. Callers that import them are updated to pass the new argument. Several edits look unrelated: a config currency change, a legacy label tweak, and calls to same-named methods.

groups.title: formatPrice gains a currency parameter
groups.description: The signature now requires a currency and the output is prefixed with it. Check that no caller is left without the new argument.

groups.title: formatPrice callers pass 'USD'
groups.description: Checkout, invoice, receipt and the re-export alias caller now pass 'USD'. Check that USD is right for each, given config.json changes to EUR.

groups.title: tax gains an optional rate
groups.description: tax takes a rate defaulting to 0.1, so existing calls keep their behavior. Check the default matches the old hard-coded value.

groups.title: tax callers pass a 0.2 rate
groups.description: order_total and refund now pass 0.2, which changes the tax they compute from the old 0.1. Confirm that is intended.

groups.title: Edits unrelated to the signature changes
groups.description: These look unrelated: a currency config switch to EUR, a legacy label change calling a different formatPrice, and two calls to same-named methods on other classes whose argument changed.

edgeVerdicts.reason: The receiver f is typed Fmt, so this calls the Fmt.formatPrice method, not the function in price.ts.
